mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate directly reduces the risk-free rate, lowering the discount rate for equity valuation models and increasing the present value of future cash flows, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days without any threshold condition.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances with FEDFUNDS < 2.5%, or the Rank IC over the last 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the year-over-year change in CPI exceeds 3.5%, it signals persistent inflation that triggers a central bank tightening response, leading to higher discount rates and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where CPIAUCSL YoY change exceeds 3.5%, or the Rank IC over the last 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in unemployment rate and increase in non-farm payrolls indicates a strong labor market that boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where UNRATE declines and PAYEMS increases, or the Rank IC for the interaction term falls below 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: During a housing market expansion, rising new housing starts (HOUST) and strong consumer spending (RSAFS) signal robust economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances during housing market expansions (defined as HOUST > 1200 and RSAFS > 500000), or the Rank IC for the interaction term falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A rising industrial production index (INDPRO) indicates expanding manufacturing output and economic activity, which typically precedes stronger corporate profits and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days without any threshold condition.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where INDPRO is rising, or the Rank IC over the last 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate falls below 3.5%, it signals a tight labor market that may lead to wage inflation and central bank tightening, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where UNRATE < 3.5%, or the Rank IC over the last 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in new housing starts (HOUST) and consumer spending (RSAFS) indicates strong aggregate demand, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where HOUST and RSAFS both increase, or the Rank IC for the interaction term falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle, rising federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS > 4.0%) signals higher interest rates that reduce equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances with FEDFUNDS > 4.0%, or the Rank IC over the last 3 years is below 0.03.
